message: We are writing you this letter to let you know about a bar that Robert Hooper built. We are sending you four pictures of our Camel bar. He designed the bar himself. He painted and woodburned the Camel picture on the front of the bar. It is built out of knotty pine wood. It has a crushed blue velvet cloth top around the glass on the top of the bar. We have purchased bar signs for the bar and a chandelier. Some of the Camel stuff we bought, like the Camel towel, Camel tin, license plate, and blue ash tray. We got one ashtray by purchasing Camel cigarettes. We have also purchased lighters, coasters, shot glass, mug, sunglasses and T-shirts with Camel ads. We just recently purchased a Camel clock. The bar isn't completely finished off; we need to purchase a refrigerator for it, varnish it, and seal the glass edges on the top.
